result.rationale: Havasu was a 2025 FBO-asset and airport-leasehold add-on to Tallvine-backed Velocity, not a separately held platform. The local assignee is Velocity Havasu Holdings, LLC; KHII now operates as Velocity Lake Havasu, and no later ownership change was found.

acquisitionExitCheck.result: No later sale, exit, recapitalization or lease reassignment found. On 2026-08-10 Velocity remained Tallvine-backed and listed KHII among six locations; AirNav showed current Velocity activity dated 2026-08-18.

milestones.event: Odyssey Aviation North America rebranded as Velocity FBO Network.
City approved transfer of Sites 3, 4 and 6 leases and Sites 1 and 2 fueling sublease to Velocity Havasu Holdings, LLC.
Velocity announced completed acquisition of Havasu FBO assets; sellers retained aircraft management and Northstar maintenance.
Velocity remained Tallvine-backed and included KHII among six locations.
